projects.name: Cache coherent, Out of Order, Multi-core RISC-V CPU
projects.summary: Developed a parametric multi-core RISC-V emulator capable of running bare-metal multi-core programs and booing Linux in multi-core mode. Developed an Instruction Fetch Unit (IFU) with a TAGE branch predictor, which is capable of achieving the desired performance goals on an FPGA. Developed a multi-threading benchmark suite for benchmarking and testing multi-core RISC-V CPU Implemented a Cache Coherent, Out of Order, Multi-core RISC-V CPU on FPGA capable of booting Linux in multi-core mode.
